Acme Widgets

We make handmade, durable widgets and ship them worldwide in two to three business days. Every widget is inspected by hand before it leaves our workshop, and every order ships with free returns for thirty days. Our small team has been crafting widgets for over a decade, and we stand behind every single piece we make. Browse our catalog below to find the widget that's right for you, or reach out if you have a custom request — we love a good challenge.

Our Widgets

Each widget starts as a raw billet of aircraft-grade aluminum, machined on our workshop's only lathe by whoever drew the short straw that morning. We anodize every piece in small batches, which means colors vary slightly from run to run — we consider that a feature, not a bug. Once assembled, every widget is tested by dropping it from a stepladder onto a concrete floor, because if it survives that, it will survive your junk drawer. We keep detailed records of every batch, right down to which employee dropped which widget, and we're happy to share that history if you ever want to know your widget's full backstory.
